TAL_UNMAKING_MERIDIAN_RUIN_SHOCK.why: On a Ruin Channel hit through an Internal Channel (an unarmed strike) or a Ruin Needle, you may spend 1 CP: the target makes a Constitution save -- failed: until the end of its next turn it cannot regain CP, has Disadvantage on Concentration saves and cannot take Reactions; successful: no Reactions until the start of your next turn. Then you gain 1 Black Vein Strain (combat/unmaking.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_RUIN_NEEDLE.why: A Ruin Channel hit through a needle, dart, hairpin or spike weapon: choose one -- no Reactions, or no CP regained, until the start of your next turn, or Disadvantage on its next Concentration save before the end of its next turn; the needle gains 1 Crack (combat/unmaking.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_RUIN_SHEATH_METHOD.why: Your Ruin Channel lasts until the end of your next turn; if it runs out without a hit you choose the Proficiency Bonus self-damage, 1 Crack on a weapon, or 1 Black Vein Strain (combat/ext/unmaking_forms.py, combat/unmaking.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_SHRED_THE_TEMPORARY_SHAPE.why: When an Unmaking talent damages a summoned or bound creature you may spend 1 CP for 3d8 + Proficiency Bonus more Ruin damage; if that drops it to 0 HP you regain 1 CP (once per turn) (combat/unmaking.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_WEAPON_PAYS_FIRST.why: Once per turn, when an Unmaking talent would give one of your weapons Crack, you may take twice your Proficiency Bonus in Ruin damage instead (combat/ext/unmaking_channels.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_BLACK_TRACE.label: Black Trace
TAL_UNMAKING_BLACK_TRACE.why: Aimed at a map object, Black Trace rolls its attack against the object's AC and deals its Realm damage plus the Crack effect's Proficiency Bonus; an Unbound Trace still asks for its price afterwards (combat/ext/objects.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_RUIN_WAVE.label: Ruin Wave
TAL_UNMAKING_RUIN_WAVE.why: Objects in the line take the wave's damage automatically, no saving throw (combat/ext/objects.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_THIRD_RUIN_FORM_SEVERING_WA.label: Third Ruin Form: Severing Wave
TAL_UNMAKING_THIRD_RUIN_FORM_SEVERING_WA.why: Objects in the line take 12d8 Ruin damage automatically (combat/ext/objects.py).

TAL_UNMAKING_SIXTH_RUIN_FORM_STAR_SUNDER.label: Sixth Ruin Form: Star-Sundering Cut
TAL_UNMAKING_SIXTH_RUIN_FORM_STAR_SUNDER.why: Objects, doors and structures in the line take 24d10 Ruin damage automatically (combat/ext/objects.py).

IMBUEMENT_BASE_PLACE_MANDATE.why: One "Place Mandate: <option>" Action per Imbue option you know (30 feet, Concentration up to 10 minutes); placing more Mandates than your Mandate Load ends your oldest (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

IMBUEMENT_BASE_FRAY_MANDATE.why: One "Fray Mandate: <option>" Action per Fray option you know: a Wisdom save, and on a failure the option lands, repeating the save at the end of each of the target's turns (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.clarify_and_clo.why: Clarify: Advantage on checks with one mental ability; Cloud: Disadvantage on mental checks and a Concentrating target's next Concentration save. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.physique_and_we.why: Physique: Advantage on checks with one physical ability; Weakness: Disadvantage on physical checks. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.fortify_and_exp.why: Fortify: +Proficiency Bonus to one saving throw; Expose: Disadvantage on the next save of one kind. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.quicken_and_slo.why: Quicken: +10/15/20/25 feet of Speed by CL; Slow: Speed halved (augment: no Disengage). A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.harden_and_brit.why: Harden on armor: Temporary HP each turn; the 2 CP augments on a creature: Resistance, or losing one / +PB from the next hit. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.lighten_and_bur.why: Burden: Speed -10 feet, no Dash, Disadvantage against being knocked Prone or moved. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.sharpen_and_dul.why: Sharpen: +PB once per turn with the chosen weapon; Dull: -PB once per turn from it. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.tempered_equipm.why: Temper: +half PB to attack and damage with a weapon, or to AC with armor. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.elemental_mantl.why: Once per turn +1d6 (2d6/3d6/4d6 by CL) of the chosen element with the chosen weapon. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.guided_vessel.why: Treacherous Shot: Disadvantage on attacks with the chosen ranged weapon. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.reflex_edict.why: Lagging Reflex: the target cannot make Opportunity Attacks. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.quiet_and_resou.why: Quiet: Advantage on Stealth checks; Resound: Disadvantage on Stealth checks. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.suppress_functi.why: Still Tongue: Silenced; Seal Sense: Blinded or Deafened. A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.rebel_vessel.why: The chosen weapon imposes Disadvantage on its bearer's attacks (a Dexterity save). A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.true_tempering_.why: Temper with Hungry Edge (+key modifier once per turn) or Guardian Shell (-PB from incoming damage once per round). A Place/Fray Mandate option (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.layered_mandate.why: Mandate Load +1, and "Place Mandate: Layered Mandate (1 CP)": two different Imbue options you know on one willing target with the same Action, no saving throw (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.sovereign_of_th.why: Mandate Load + Proficiency Bonus; Place and Fray Mandate reach 120 feet (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.twin_fray.why: "Fray Mandate: Twin Fray (2 CP)": two different Fray options you know on one creature, one saving throw decides both (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.imbuement.touch_carried_m.why: On a hit, you may spend 1 CP to put one Fray option you know on the target as part of the attack (its own saving throw, with Disadvantage when the weapon bears your Imbue Mandate) (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

IMBUEMENT_BASE_COUNTER_MANDATE.why: "Counter-Mandate: free an ally" / "strip a foe" (1 CP), offered against another cultivator's Mandate on the creature: an Imbuement Check against its DC (a Fray's save DC, an Imbue's 10 + its creator's PB + key modifier); a success ends it (combat/ext/imbuement_mandates.py).

tianxia.talent.sabers.short_saber_infigh.why: After a hit with a duan dao, butterfly saber or other short saber on a creature within 5 feet, you may shove it as part of the same Action; a shoved creature is Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn (combat/ext/sabers_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.blood.bloodletting_strike.why: When you hit with a melee attack or Blood Thread you may spend 1 CP: +1d6 Necrotic, and the target makes a Constitution save or takes Necrotic damage equal to your PB at the start of its next turn (combat/ext/blood_riders.py).

tianxia.talent.blood.crimson_feast.why: Once per turn, when you damage a Bloodied creature bearing your Blood Thread, you may spend 2 CP: 2d6/3d6/4d6 Necrotic by CL, and you regain HP equal to your PB, never above half your maximum HP (combat/ext/blood_riders.py).

TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_BLOODLESS_DEVOU.why: Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature below half its maximum HP, you may spend 1 Devoured Essence to choose a printed benefit (combat/ext/bloodless_devouring.py).

TAL_DAEMONIC_CULTIVATION_THOUSAND_HUNGER.why: When you take one of ten printed damage types while Demon Seed is active, you may spend 1 Devoured Essence to gain Resistance to that type until the start of your next turn (until the end of it at CL 11); at CL 17 your next damage roll with any Daemonic talent deals additional damage OF THAT ADAPTED TYPE equal to your Proficiency Bonus (combat/ext/thousand_hunger.py).

tianxia.talent.blood.crimson_mark.why: When Blood Thread hits, you may spend 1 CP: the target makes a Constitution save or your Blood Thread on it lasts 1 hour (combat/ext/blood_riders.py).
